icons.instructions: Use Lucide React icons. Stroke width 2 for standard UI, stroke width 2.5 for emphasized CTAs or KPIs. Default size 20, Sidebar size 20.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly apply the Primary Color #9933FF for active states, primary buttons, and critical data visualizations. Do not use generic tailwind blue or indigo.
Data Currency Format: ALL financial values must be prefixed with 'S/' (Peruvian Sol) and formatted to 2 decimal places. e.g. S/ 15,240.50
Branding Restrictions: Display the 'ENERED' logo prominently at the top of the sidebar. Do NOT show the client company name anywhere in the UI. Instead, use generic 'Bienvenido' or the User's Name.
Layout Restrictions: The design must feature a left sidebar (hidden on mobile, toggleable via hamburger menu), top sticky header, followed by KPI bento grid, and then the chart section.

Component Strategy: Use Shadcn UI for structural interactive components (select, dropdown, dialog, tables) but customize them to match the 6px rounded-md border-radius and exact colors. Use Recharts for all 5 requested charts.
Mobile Responsiveness: This is a strict requirement. KPI grids collapse to 1 column. Charts must have 100% width and responsive containers. Tables must be wrapped in overflow-x-auto.
Typography: Use Cabinet Grotesk for Headings and Manrope for body text. Make sure to import them via Google Fonts or standard CDN if not present in the template.
WhatsApp Support: The Support Module is a static contact UI. Clicking the button must open a 'wa.me' link.
